actions.title: Return safely to the Academy base branch
actions.instruction: After completing U06, use a native terminal at the Academy clone root to return to main and confirm the checkout is clean before preparing U07. This preserves the completed U06 attempt branch.
actions.rationale: U07 Prepare creates its own numbered branch from main; it must not start from a previous lesson attempt.
actions.expected_result: HEAD is on main and git status --short prints nothing; the completed U06 attempt branch remains intact.
actions.recovery: If switching branches would overwrite or hide work, stop and preserve that work on its existing branch. Do not force-switch, reset, rebase, delete, or alter the earlier attempt. Next safe step: return only after the checkout is clean.
actions.evidence: The branch name and clean status establish the base-branch precondition for the U07 attempt.

actions.title: Prepare the bounded fix attempt
actions.instruction: From a clean main branch at the Academy clone root, run Prepare in a native terminal. Academy creates the numbered attempt branch and seeds one known control-character defect. Stay on that branch for the capstone.
actions.rationale: The fixture makes the implementation boundary inspectable without replacing codeArbiter's fix workflow.
actions.expected_result: Academy prints academy/U07-capstone/ATTEMPT_NUMBER. The branch is clean and tests/test_service.py contains a passing case that shows the existing resolution behavior accepts a control character. The fix lane will add the missing resolution regression.
actions.recovery: If Prepare names a dirty-worktree, branch, or remote problem, preserve the message and repair only that condition. Do not force-reset main or borrow another lesson's history.
actions.evidence: Keep the printed attempt branch and verify that git status --short is empty before entering the fix lane.

actions.title: Repair the known defect through the fix lane
actions.instruction: Use the fix command. Add the missing resolution regression, observe RED, make the minimal repair, and run affected service checks.
actions.rationale: The fix lane owns the regression, minimal repair, affected verification, and commit gate.
actions.expected_result: The regression and repair are ready for one green commit.
actions.recovery: If the proposed scope expands or the fix lane reports a stop, do not hand-write substitute artifacts. Preserve the branch and resolve the named real gate, or use Reset for a new attempt.
actions.evidence: Actual checks and committed source; no feature classification is required.

actions.title: Open and inspect your fork pull request
actions.instruction: Request the governed commit of the green fix, then choose Open a PR at the branch handoff. Confirm the base repository is your personal fork before creation. Leave the PR open; do not merge.
actions.rationale: The bounded fix ends through a real hosted PR. Academy must not imitate that event with a local file.
actions.expected_result: A real open PR inside your fork with the intended base and head.
actions.recovery: If no PR opens, keep the clean branch and use the real delivery workflow's recovery. Do not write a local PR receipt or claim a review that did not happen.
actions.evidence: Retain the browser URL. Academy does not authenticate a hosted event.

actions.title: Check durable local evidence
actions.instruction: Run Check after the committed fix is clean. It inspects the prepared baseline, test, service behavior, safe remotes, and worktree.
actions.rationale: Check independently verifies durable repository facts without claiming that a harness command, review, PR, CI run, or merge occurred.
actions.expected_result: The local fix passes its bounded Check.
actions.recovery: Read the failed predicate and correct the real branch boundary it identifies. Do not create a PR, review, CI, or approval receipt to influence Check.
actions.evidence: Local evidence; hosted review and CI are separate.

actions.title: Preserve the branch before a retry
actions.instruction: Use Reset only if this attempt cannot be repaired. Run it from the matching clean Academy attempt branch. Academy archives the current branch before creating a new numbered attempt.
actions.rationale: A preserved retry leaves the failed fix evidence inspectable and avoids rewriting history or deleting a real hosted branch.
actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the old attempt on an academy/archive/U07-capstone timestamped branch and prints a clean next attempt branch.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, preserve its output and current branch. Resolve only the stated repository condition. Never force-reset, rebase, delete the old attempt, or close a real PR to make the retry easier.
actions.evidence: The archive branch and the new numbered branch remain reachable for separate inspection.
